summary_1line: Ravana meets Narada, who advises him to challenge Yama instead of tormenting mortals, prompting Ravana to boastfully march toward the realm of Death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands in the aerial chariot Pushpaka while the sage Narada sits upon a glowing cloud speaking to him across the sky.
Narada pauses in mid‑air like a smokeless fire, deep in thought about Ravana daring to confront Yama, lord of death.
Ravana laughs like thunder and turns his chariot southward, declaring he will storm the city of Yama.
